dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You could use this ranking as a guide when facing enemies.

dialogues.speaker: Leifhelm
dialogues.text: That is true... You know what? I'll come up with a "Hypothetical Opponent Ranking" when I have the time.

dialogues.speaker: Leifhelm
dialogues.text: No matter how I look at it, the Lupus Boreas and Decarabian would belong in the "Super Gods and Demons" tier... In that case, wouldn't Rächer of Solnari be in the "Ultra Gods and Demons" tier?

dialogues.speaker: Leifhelm
dialogues.text: Oh, I should mention — we've had quite a few signs of wolf activity around here lately. Since they tell me you're a pretty famous Adventurer, Honorary Knight, I figured you'd be interested in knowing that?
